planner.question: Which explicit structural restrictions allow polynomial witness-to-deterministic-circuit compilation, and what happens when they are removed?
planner.strategy: Contract a shared-state graph of repeated witness passes using a supplied frontier layout.
planner.alternative: Reduce CNF SAT to a width-three verifier with two differently ordered witness passes.
planner.stop_rule: Do not confuse uniform compilation hardness with nonuniform circuit lower bounds or ignore witness consistency.
literature_leads: Prior MathOS bit-witness consistency; elementary finite-state graph frontier DP and standard 3SAT NP-completeness. No novelty claim.

construct.claim: A repeated-witness finite-state verifier has exact deterministic circuit compilation in h W^(c+2r) poly(L) time/size for a supplied frontier layout.
construct.scope: r permutations of h shared witness bits, explicit W states, polynomially constructible transition predicates, counted multiedges.
construct.derivation: Identify witness occurrences, label intervening edges by states, enforce one bit at each vertex, contract local predicates while retaining crossing state assignments.
unresolved_steps: Universal useful layout guarantee for unrestricted input-dependent NP verifier families.
candidate_tests: Compile all small two-pass fixtures and replay against exhaustive witness enumeration.

alternative.claim: Existential projection of two differently ordered width-three passes is NP-complete.
alternative.scope: Explicit transition tables; fixed formula encoded in program; nonempty CNF clauses.
alternative.derivation: Use one bit per literal occurrence, check clauses in pass one and consistency of variable occurrences in pass two.
unresolved_steps: Nonuniform lower-bound transfer for an input-dependent family; no unrestricted runtime lower bound.
candidate_tests: All 256 small CNF subsets, occurrence-model equivalence, actual compilation on small fixtures.

objections: Frontier layout is supplied, not discovered for free.
Constant pass count and width alone do not ensure tractability.
Formula-specific no-input verifier has a trivial constant deterministic circuit; compiler cost is essential.
One-bit transition prototype is not a general machine compiler.
counterexample_candidates: Clause-order versus variable-order occurrence passes encode general SAT.
critic.equivalence_audit: One bit per vertex, shared edge states and exact frontier contraction; uniform/nonuniform transfer distinguished.
critic.barrier_audit: Restricted compilation theorem and NP-completeness, not a proof of P!=NP.

cost.computational_model: Explicit finite states and transition circuits, bit-cost gate construction.
